summary: Grows a dynamic buffer. Computes the new capacity as this[3] (growth increment) plus this[1] (current capacity), stores it back to this+0x4, calls sub_58B5D4 with the old buffer pointer (this[5]) and the byte size new_capacity times this[2] (element stride), then stores the returned pointer into this+0x14 and returns it.

local_names.this: dynamic buffer descriptor (capacity at +0x4, stride at +0x8, increment at +0xC, buffer pointer at +0x14)
local_names.v2: new capacity = growth increment + current capacity
local_names.v3: previous buffer pointer read from this[5]
local_names.result: sub_58B5D4 return value, stored as the new buffer pointer

operations.description: New capacity v2 computed as this[3] (growth increment) plus this[1] (current capacity)
Stores the new capacity v2 back into this[1] at offset 0x4
Calls sub_58B5D4 with the old buffer pointer (this[5]) and byte size v2 times this[2] (element stride)
Stores the realloc result as the new buffer pointer at this+0x14
Returns the new buffer pointer from sub_58B5D4
Invoked by AudioStackPushWithOverflowRealloc when the buffer is full and must grow

unresolved: sub_58B5D4 exact realloc semantics (and whether it frees the old block) are defined outside this packet
